chapter: The levee club and the St. Louis scene
title: A roadhouse at Clayton Bottoms
summary: Thomas took a trolley to Clayton Bottoms, where brickyard workers and wrestlers visited the musical spots at the top of the hill.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Oh, you mean where you were working on the levee?
No. I'm going back to the roadhouse now. We can change our spots here and there. And, so I take a trolley to

Clayton Bottoms and there's a brickyard there. People work in the brickyards there. But, up top of the hill there are about three or four musical spots there and one our spot a lot of nice things used to happen and fellows who were prominent in those days and doing different things, like wrestlers, them kind of cats, just stop in and say hello (?.) But, there was one guy I'll never forget.
